text:
amal: Found a debug archive uploaded to gs://redwood-dev-artifacts/debug-bundles/2026-03-23/instance-42.tar.gz that includes a VAULT_TOKEN and a GCP service account key. Marking P0 for rotation/containment. :rotating_light:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-145 created (severity: high). Notifying oncall.

marta: Can you paste the bundle path + masked grep output so we can scope?

amal: Path above. Grep (masked):

```
VAULT_TOKEN=***vault-token-xxxx***
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/sa-key.json
{"type": "service_account", "project_id": "redwood-dev", "private_key_id": "***", "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n***\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

amal: I didn't paste raw secrets. Bucket lifecycle currently 30d and has org-public access with a few external collaborators.

darius: Suggested playbook: 1) Revoke Vault token accessor immediately. 2) Revoke any leases issued by that token. 3) Delete the SA key, create a new minimal-scoped key. 4) Rewrap any objects encrypted with the old KMS key; consider rekeying transit. 5) Tighten bucket ACL and set TTL to 24h. 6) Enable Vault audit logging (json) for 7d.

jonathan: Ops, can you run the gcloud/key revoke? Also need to check token activity against prod paths.

ops-oncall: Running now. Commands:
```
vault token-revoke -accessor "***accessor***"
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=debug-sa@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-dev
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-sa-key.json --iam-account=debug-sa@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-dev
```

ops-oncall: Revocation and key delete completed; new key created and uploaded to Vault under policy "debug-limited" (short TTL).

marta: I'll run Vault audit & GCP logs for 48h to check usage.

amal: Quick triage: Vault audit shows token-lookup calls from instance-42 and a KV read at secret/data/dev/feature-flags. No prod reads. GCP logs show the SA used to upload the bundle at 2026-03-23T03:12Z.

darius: Proceed with rewrap for legacy-KMS-01 objects; schedule rekey for transit-KMS-02 in next maintenance window (ETA ~6h). Add allowlist so debug SA cannot access prod buckets.

jonathan: Opening RBAC PR to remove storage.objectAdmin from debug-sa and grant limited roles (objectCreator/viewer) scoped to the debug bucket. Also enabling uniform bucket-level access and 24h lifecycle.

marta: Enabling full Vault audit sink -> central logging GCS for 7 days, indexing into Splunk. Enabling GCP object access logs on the debug bucket.

amal: Action items:
- revoke token + delete old SA key (ops-oncall) — done
- create new scoped SA key + store in Vault (ops-oncall) — done
- rewrap/rotate transit key (darius) — in progress
- RBAC scoping PR (jonathan) — in review/PR merged shortly
- enable Vault/GCP audit sinks (marta) — in progress
- change bucket lifecycle to 24h & block public access (jonathan) — in PR

security-bot: Audit: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-145 (log ids attached).

ops-oncall: Confirmed gcloud delete response OK and Vault token revoke acknowledged. New key stored as secret/debug/new-sa-key (lease 1h).

darius: Rewrap completed for objects encrypted with legacy-KMS-01. Filed ticket to rotate transit-KMS-02 after maintenance window.

marta: Audit results: no prod secret reads. Two denied attempts to access partner-integration secrets were recorded; set alert for any denied->allowed transitions.

jonathan: RBAC and bucket policy PR merged; lifecycle TTL set to 24h and uniform access enforced.

amal: Scheduling 1hr blameless postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PT. Recommendation: default debug agent should scrub env files and avoid uploading credentials.

marta: I'll invite infra, devex, security, and product to the postmortem.

amal: Updating INC-2026-145 with timeline and owners; closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
